lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in discrete vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The columns exhibit a semi-regular spatial frequency, with approximately 3-4 primary nodes per vertical band visible in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. Each ridge manifests as a linear boundary with higher luminance on the superior aspect and a shadow gradient on the inferior aspect, extending longitudinally from the gill region toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (likely Echeneidae) visible near the pectoral fin and ventral midline; the left pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank.
